scope: Editor-only fixed enable/disable functions; no external route, arbitrary target or credential access
privacy: Only fixed result codes or nonsecret ok/stage metadata logged. Raw errors, config, ACL and journal are never logged.
fixes: Validate boolean argument before state access
Require actual nonempty string review/approval refs
Prepare restrictive config before write; if write acknowledgement or readback fails, attempt AUTH_CONNECT rollback and verify it
Never restore AUTH04 after a failed disable
Explicit STATE_UNCONFIRMED_STOP_AND_DISABLE_REQUIRED if restrictive rollback cannot be confirmed
python_integration_review: Both entry route and native_context now use validated fixed-path load_config. Invalid config stops before legacy routes. Existing runtime credential use, OIDC bridge validation, GAS target pins and 900-second margin remain unchanged. No agent-visible secret retrieval introduced.
operational_conditions: Keep frontend disabled until GAS helper success and configuration stage readback are confirmed
Helper false/unknown response is not activation or rollback success; do not issue business requests
If rollback state is unconfirmed, stop and perform authorized disable; do not retry enable blindly
Store actual review/PI evidence refs before activation; review flags do not substitute for completed checks
Credentials incident and original real60m boundary evidence remain unresolved under separate documented limited-test risk acceptance
